purpose: Design of the shared agenda mechanism that records, validates state transitions of, and renders discussion items (review findings, consult topics) via JSON storage and CLI scripts.
summary: Overview: storage layer and display layer split, JSON format, one-way dependency consult -> wrapper -> store
Architecture: agenda_wrapper, agenda_store, agenda_render, agenda_schema modules and their responsibilities
Data schema of agenda.json: content_version, config, structural_judgment, items, decision, last_changed_fields
State representation without a status field: an item is settled when decision by/outcome/reason are all non-empty
State transition rules: structural judgment required first, background and essence required before decision
Structural judgment re-required when a new item is added, done atomically in one record call
Input interface: wrapper CLI start/record/pending/next/finish, one value per record call, no AI-built JSON
Placement, count and lifetime of records per origin (review/consult), deletion on all items settled
Automatic re-render trigger after each successful write, with partial status on render failure
Test design and measurement method for reduced AI output (FNC-004)
tasks: Implementing or modifying agenda_store, agenda_wrapper, agenda_schema
Changing the agenda.json schema or adding fields
Designing state transition or settlement rules
Writing tests for the agenda mechanism
title: DES-075 agenda 機構 設計書
